messages.content: Every day, a tree drops 7 leaves. How many leaves would it drop in a month of February in a non-leap year? Include your logic.
February has 28 days in a non-leap year. At 7 leaves per day, the tree drops 7 x 28 = 196 leaves. So the answer is 196 leaves.
What was the purpose of the Colosseum in Rome?
The Colosseum was used for public spectacles such as gladiator fights, animal hunts, executions, mock battles, and other large entertainments.
